item.text: {"iteration":1,"pcvs":[{"name":"batch_size","expression":"len(engine_core_outputs)","rationale":"Captures per-output iteration, detokenization, and request-output construction overhead."},{"name":"finished_requests","expression":"sum(o.finish_reason is not None for o in engine_core_outputs)","rationale":"Captures request cleanup and completion-statistics processing."},{"name":"prefilling_requests","expression":"sum(self.request_states[o.request_id].is_prefilling for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states)","rationale":"Captures first-output statistics and prefill-state transitions."},{"name":"accumulated_output_tokens","expression":"sum(len(self.request_states[o.request_id].detokenizer.output_token_ids) + len(o.new_token_ids) for o in engine_core_outputs if o.request_id in self.request_states and self.request_states[o.request_id].detokenizer is not None)","rationale":"Captures accumulated generation length affecting incremental decoding and cumulative output construction."}],"hypothesis":"Instruction count is primarily linear in batch size, with additional costs for first outputs, finished requests, and accumulated generation length."}
